approval_boundary: Any future Gateway restart or repair execution requires separate explicit approval

plan.details: Runtime-log-only scanner; exclude agent session jsonl/trajectory/transcripts and checker source text; classify transcript matches as false positives, never health failures.
Start at SIGUSR1 received / restart event; include bounded startup window and stabilization window; separate stale/pre-restart from post-restart-only signals.
Keep real liveness/Telegram failures fail-closed; allow only documented grace readback after startup if no new liveness warnings appear.
Require gateway status RPC OK, PID/readback, queue depth 0, Telegram ON/OK 1/1, and runtime-log-only clean window.
No Telegram probe sends, external sends, provider/model shadow calls, route/config/memory/Context Bridge mutation.
Fresh M3N N2/N3 retry is required after repair. Resume from N2/N3 only if N0/N1 baseline hashes remain stable; otherwise restart from N0/N1. Future Gateway restart requires explicit approval.

resume_from: N2/N3 after repaired validator if N0/N1 stability revalidated; otherwise N0/N1
rollback_readiness: PASS backups present and no runtime/config mutation in this preservation pass
